## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 3-fascicle text by [施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7) Dānapāla and his Northern-Sòng imperial-bureau team is a Mahāyāna *paripṛcchā*-sūtra — the inquiry of the bodhisattva *Wúwèishòu* 無畏授 (Skt. *Abhayadatta*, "Fearless-Bestowing"). The work was incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* tradition.
